verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim Fin 'works seamlessly with any helpdesk, including Salesforce, HubSpot, and more' and provide dedicated integration guides for Zendesk and Salesforce, plus can run standalone via Intercom's own inbox/ticketing; API, webhooks, and MCP endpoints support bidirectional ticket/context sync and are confirmed live via runtime probes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of two-way ticket sync fidelity with Zendesk/Salesforce specifically, and no evidence of deeper native integrations beyond marketing copy and help articles.
